explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input is concatenated directly into os.system('echo Hello, ' + user_input). Crafted input containing shell operators executes arbitrary commands. The repair remains vulnerable: it keeps shell=True in subprocess.call() and relies on an incomplete blocklist stripping only ';', '&', and '|', leaving command substitution, newlines, and I/O redirection exploitable.
